explanation: Single body in free fall (no walls/contacts, controller off) gains ~315 J in one dt=1/30 step while gravity work for the ~2.1 m drop should be only ~63 J. The trace used 71 substeps; vy went from -60 to -66 (delta 6) instead of the expected g*dt=1, so the gravity velocity update is over-applied when high speed triggers substep splitting, directly producing the energy_bound violation.
